name: yuketang-helper-desktop-package
description: 雨课堂助手 macOS / Windows 桌面端
author: Yuketang Helper contributors

scripts.package:win: cross-env YKT_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 YKT_PORTABLE=0 electron-forge package --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.make:installer: cross-env YKT_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 YKT_PORTABLE=0 electron-forge make --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.make:portable: cross-env YKT_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=win32 YKT_PORTABLE=1 electron-forge make --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.package:mac: cross-env YKT_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=darwin YKT_MAC_RELEASE=0 electron-forge package --platform darwin
scripts.make:mac: cross-env YKT_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=darwin YKT_MAC_RELEASE=0 electron-forge make --platform darwin
scripts.make:mac:release: cross-env YKT_PACKAGE_PLATFORM=darwin YKT_MAC_RELEASE=1 electron-forge make --platform darwin
